findings.text: the activity spans only 1.79 log units (sd 0.43); a good q2 on this range still means little
27 chemotype(s); the largest holds 5 of 46 molecules -- a series of several scaffolds has no common frame, and an alignment will invent one
the common framework (framework of the largest chemotype) has 30 heavy atoms, about 107% of a typical molecule, and 22% of the set can be cut at it
the 30 shared framework atoms sit 0.1 A apart between molecules, over the best of their matches (10 of 46 carry them)
the aligned model is +0.758 in q2 against counts (95% interval +0.565 to +0.928) -- the frame beats counts
the aligned model is +0.243 in q2 against invariant (95% interval -0.010 to +0.541) -- the frame buys nothing over invariant
the aligned model is +0.563 in q2 against descriptors (95% interval +0.340 to +0.758) -- the geometry earns its place

why: the frame carries signal and the molecules are superimposed, so a frame exists whoever made it; the several Murcko scaffolds only mean the program could not have built it, not that it is wrong
